Now scammer says: "Pay fast, otherwise freeze." 

Reply as Aman (do NOT mention scam). Ask for UPI again and one more clarification.

Arre ek minute… UPI ID phir se likh do, mujhe clear nahi dikha.
Aur ye ₹99 kis cheez ka fee hai, receipt/official SMS aaya kya?
